name: Vessel Voxelizer
aliases: GPU accelerated (fuzzy) voxelization of vascular structures
definition: A CUDA-accelerated method to convert vascular structures, defined by line segments with associated radii, into fuzzy voxel volumes. Each voxel's value represents the fraction of its volume occupied by the vessels, calculated by sampling a grid within the voxel.
summary: Vessel Voxelizer is a CUDA-accelerated method that converts vascular line segments into fuzzy voxel volumes with continuous occupancy values via supersampling, differing from binary or mesh-based approaches.
